clarification. Applicant also acknowledges that there weas a paragraph without a number designation, and requests guidance for correction.

In light of the above noted amendments and remarks, this application is believed in condition for allowance and notice thereof is respectfully solicited. The Examiner is urged to contact applicant's attorney at 503-312-0318 if there are any questions.
